Before [[3964 BBY]], a '''solar observatory''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Metellos 3]] was defunded in order to pay for the construction of the [[Flashpoint Stellar Research Station]].
